thread:
maria: noticed compact table in Console — action icons overlap row click on hover. clicked kebab twice and it opened row instead :grimacing:
jon: can reproduce on Mac Chrome. looks like we tightened spacing tokens recently.
kelly: i'd rather not change spacing tokens globally. can we expand the actual button hit area instead?
sam: suggestion: add an invisible :before layer with larger hit area or increase button padding but keep visual size with negative margins. also consider pointer-events on container.
maria: agreed — prefer adjusting hit area on buttons, avoid token changes. also need keyboard & screen reader checks.
design-bot: accessibility notes: ensure :focus-within enables pointer-events; use 44px minimum tap target on touch; for toasts avoid ambiguous messages — prefer "Model saved" vs "Saved" and use aria-live properly.
jon: i'll prototype button hitbox + pointer-events fallback and add a cypress test to assert row click not triggered when clicking action.
kelly: i'll produce a quick mock and copy variants for toasts by EOD Tue.
maria: thanks — tagging frontend.
design-bot: summary: implement internal hitbox expansion or :before hit layer, fallback mobile tap target 44px, avoid global spacing token changes, make toast copy contextual. :white_check_mark:
